title: MLOps Engineering: From Models to Production
description: A hands-on, project-based course that takes you from containerizing ML workloads to building fully automated, monitored, and cloud-deployed machine learning pipelines — including a dedicated module on serving large language models efficiently on GPUs. You'll master Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLflow, infrastructure as code, production monitoring, and modern LLMOps (vLLM, quantization, KServe, and GPU-aware scaling) while building a portfolio of deployable systems.
audience: Data scientists, software engineers, and DevOps practitioners who want to transition into an MLOps Engineer role and need practical skills in deploying, automating, and monitoring machine learning systems — including LLMs — in production.
